message.content: I just got home from my shift. My head is spinning. Can you draft a quick text to Julien? I need to tell him I’m picking up the groceries on my way back so we don’t have to stop later. Keep it short.

content.text:
Here is a draft for Julien:

"Hey love, just clocked out. I’m grabbing the groceries on my way back so we can skip the shop tomorrow. See you soon."

Shall I send it now?

content.text: For a 2kg roast, you should remove it from the oven 20 minutes before it reaches the target internal temperature to let it rest. If you start it at 12 PM, depending on your oven and desired doneness, it will likely be ready to rest around 2:30 PM. This gives you time to get to Parents' house by 3 PM, leaving a buffer for traffic.
